review_cost.rationale: Approve-with-comments: everything that matters (correctness, a11y structure, SSR behavior) is right, and the remaining asks are a shared-folder move and small nits.

findings.issue: humanize (and the label/dash/sprite helper family) is duplicated between client composables and server utils, so the two copies can drift
findings.suggestion: Move shared pure helpers into Nuxt 4's shared/utils/ directory, which is auto-imported on both the app and server sides

findings.issue: Hand-rolled TTL/promise-dedup cache; expired entries that are never revisited are never evicted (only failed fetches delete keys)
findings.suggestion: Use Nitro's cachedFunction/cachedEventHandler (auto-imported in server code) for TTL caching and in-flight dedup, which also evicts expired entries

findings.issue: Promise.all fan-out over up to ~180 move fetches per request with no concurrency limit (also species.get.ts:9, versionGroups.ts:4)
findings.suggestion: Chunk the fan-out or add a small concurrency limiter; at minimum comment that the TTL cache absorbs repeat load

findings.issue: Server handlers rely on implicit `any` for API payloads; shape contracts exist only as client-side interfaces
findings.suggestion: Define response/payload interfaces next to the producers so a payload change fails at the server boundary

findings.issue: `<n> of 6` counts cookie entries while cards come from server-filtered members, so a stale team entry makes the count and list disagree
findings.suggestion: Drive the count from the fetched members (or reconcile the cookie when the server drops entries)

findings.issue: usePageData's key is evaluated once at setup, so on in-place param navigation the asyncData key no longer matches the resource
findings.suggestion: Build the key reactively or rely on Nuxt's auto-generated keys from the URL

findings.issue: onMounted fires a synthetic onSearch({target: el} as unknown as Event) to catch pre-hydration typing
findings.suggestion: Read input.value directly instead of faking an event; or drop the hack if pre-hydration input isn't a real scenario

findings.issue: Selects set both :value on the <select> and :selected on every option (redundant)
An out-of-range ?page is clamped for display but the URL keeps the bogus value
findings.suggestion: Optionally replace the URL with the clamped page for shareable/canonical links

findings.issue: learnsets rows are bare [move, method, level] tuples serialized to the client, slightly cryptic at both ends
findings.suggestion: Use named fields ({move, method, level}) in the payload

summary: A clean, current-Nuxt-4 implementation that would merge after a comments round: correct SSR/cookie-backed team state, uniform 404 handling, small composable components, and no real correctness defects. The structural asks are moving duplicated client/server helpers into Nuxt 4's shared/ folder and replacing the hand-rolled TTL cache with Nitro's cachedFunction. Everything else is nits — loose `any` in server handlers, a frozen useFetch key, and minor count/URL inconsistencies.
